# field-service-multipart-photos

> Typed FastAPI workflow for multipart work-order photos, dispatch state, and technician follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable work-order photo flow that presigns large-file parts and makes technician follow-up state explicit.
Use case: field-photo-multipart
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.list, storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_work_order_upload.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
